en: The postcard shows a black and white photograph of a waterfront scene, with rustic wooden buildings on stilts, rocky shorelines, and a pier where a steamboat is docked. Another smaller boat is also present near the pier. The water is calm, and the background includes distant low islands or mainland. Several people are visible on the pier and on the steamboat. The lower left corner of the postcard has printed text that appears to be the location name, while text in the lower right credits a photographer and inclusion of a serial number.
